collections.description: Parses Address Array from JSON to expose individual rows along with an index and MEMBER_PREFERENCES_KEY

decorativeSymbols.name: Notes
decorativeSymbols.value:
-  Addresses and Campaigns should be LEFT JOINED from the main MEMBER_PREFERENCES_VW on MEMBER_PREFERENCES_KEY because if no address or campaign data is available, no record will exist
-  Addresses are unique by MEMBER_PREFERENCES_KEY + ADDRESS_ARRAY_INDEX because a member can have multiple addresses
-  Campaigns are unique by MEMBER_PREFERENCES_KEY + CAMPAIGN_ARRAY_INDEX + CONTACT_METHODS_ARRAY_INDEX because of their nested relationship

comments: Logical model of tables and views in IDAP_LAKE where every object in here is shown as a table even though many of them are views in the database. We parse VARIANT columns in many of those views which Hackolade has a very difficult time interpreting for a model since the schema is applied at runtime. Therefor this model is to be used only to illustrate relationships for users but not to actually build or deploy anything.
author: Paul Diamond
